theme: An open day in DC, then a late flight north to Maine.
greeting: The day is largely yours until a late flight to Bangor — DCA to BGR, wheels up at 10:15 PM. The girls are with Jen, so it's a quiet solo evening on the way to Maine.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: On the PRI thread she offered Monday 12–2 PM ET or Thursday morning your time to talk, and is waiting on you to choose. She also mentioned PRI's CEO role has now been filled.

needsAttention.title: Check in for AA 3117
needsAttention.detail: Check-in is open for tonight's 10:15 PM DCA→Bangor flight (confirmation DYEOUM).

flagged.title: Eugenia — PRI call times
flagged.detail: Replied with slots to talk (Mon 12–2 PM ET or Thu morning); awaiting your pick.

inbox.noise: The usual newsletters and promos — Alison Roman, Chairish, a Talarico campaign ask, Maine Voices Live, Patreon, and a Dex digest.

resolved: Replied to Drew about Schwartzman's emergency-vet scare.

recipe.title: The splendid summer tomato sandwich
recipe.why: August tomatoes are at their peak and ask for almost nothing — a fitting, no-cook supper for a travel day that lands you in Maine close to midnight.

acts.line: An open morning — nothing was on the calendar before the train.
Amtrak from New York down to Washington, DC (in around 6:16).
Arrive in DC — the evening is your own.
